notes.title: Drums Rock - Launch Update
notes.content:
Hey Rockers! We've got an exciting announcement for you today. The highly anticipated [b]Launch Update[/b] is finally here with a launch sale (20% discount), marking the end of early access and delivering the ultimate experience! Get ready for a rocking time with these highlights:
[list]
[*] [b]Custom songs and Workshop support![/b] Unleash your creativity and take your gameplay to a whole new level.
[*] Immerse yourself in the rhythm with new mind-blowing songs like [b]Bella Ciao[/b], [b]Bring Me To Life[/b], [b]Blind and Frozen[/b] by Beast In Black, [b]Fueron Pocos[/b] by Sons Of Aguirre & Scila, [b]Survivor[/b] by Cabin Boy Jumped Ship, and [b]Last Line Of Defense[/b] by December Screams Ember.
[*] Play as The Penitent One with the [b]Blasphemous Collaboration[/b], featuring its unique song and drum set!
[*] Feel the thrill of facing off against the epic [b]new boss[/b], Lord Zeppelin.
[*] Fine-tune your drumming experience with [b]single drum position settings[/b], allowing you to customize your setup.
[*] Expand your style with the addition of [b]shop cosmetics[/b], giving you even more ways to rock out.
[*] Lastly, we've also fixed various minor bugs.
[/list]

And that's not all! We're thrilled to announce that we're working on an incredible DLC collaboration with the beloved video game Undertale, along with other iconic rock bands. Stay tuned for more updates on this epic rock tour!

Get ready to rock like never before with this incredible update! Keep on rocking!

notes.title: Drums Rock Steam Trading Cards Available Now!
notes.content:
While you face evil hordes of demon, risking your life for the rock, you might as well get something extra. Starting now, you can collect Steam Cards in Drums Rock!

To get them, play the game or trade with your friends on the Steam Community Market. Collect the full set to craft a one-of-a-kind badge, that you can display on your Steam profile. Each badge will earn you random drops of emoticons and backgrounds.

[b]Now you can enhance your Steam profile with:[/b]

[list]
[*] Regular badge (5 levels)
[*] Rockstar badge (1 level)
[*] 5 Profile backgrounds
[*] 5 Emoticons
[*] 3 Animated Avatars
[*] 3 Animated Frames
[*] Happy playing and badge crafting!
[/list]

[b]How to collect Steam Trading Cards[/b]

Play Drums Rock to get cards. Up to half the card set is dropped through game play. You can get the rest of the set by trading with other players on the Community Market.

[b]How to craft a badge[/b]

Once you’ve collected a full set of cards you can craft them into a game badge. Badges can be crafted by accessing the Badges tab on your Steam profile. There are 5 levels of a regular badge to craft and one Rock Star badge.

During badge crafting you’ll receive random rewards, such as emoticons and backgrounds.

notes.title: Drums Rock x Until You Fall Keys Contest
notes.content:
Hi Rockers! Today we have a special announcement. Along with our special collaboration with Until You Fall we are celebrating an exclusive event for Drums Rock where you’ll be able to win an [b]Until You Fall game key[/b]. To win you’ll need to show your rocker skills.


[b]Contest Rules:[/b]
[list]
[*] There’ll be a contest for every platform (Oculus Quest 2 (AppLab) and Steam)
[*] The top player in the Kneon Knightmare ranking on Hard difficulty will get a game copy. To receive your prize you’ll need to claim it on our official Discord.
[*] There’ll be another 2  copies to be raffled among all participants having obtained a punctuation in Kneon Knightmare on any difficulty. To participate you’ll need to share a screenshot of the score and name of the song, and a screenshot of a positive review of Drums Rock in the corresponding store on our official Discord.
[*] The contest will be running up until June 30, 6:00 UTC. Any screenshot shared past this date won’t be accepted into the contest. You’ll only be able to claim your prize past this date.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy Drums Rock!

[url=https://discord.gg/nQsJjfKQN8 style=button] Join to Drums Rock Discord[/url]

notes.title: Drums Rock Early Access and Free Demo Is Now Available!
notes.content:
[b]Drums Rock Early Access[/b] and [b]Free Demo[/b] Is Now Available!

[b]Drums Rock[/b] is an rhythm drums game for VR, follow the rhythm of rock with your drums and smash the demons. Live a unique campaign: with different levels, challenges, songs and worlds. Drums Rock is an ideal game to feel like a rock hero, while destroying hordes of demons to the rhythm of rock!

This is of course only the beginning. Drums Rock is just entering Early Access, and while we feel there is much to do in Drums Rock already, it’s far from complete. We have a lot of plans moving forward, and we’ll need your help in shaping the future of our game as we work towards an even bigger, even more amazing.

Play the drums like a rock hero, and survive in hell fighting against demons and their boss!

[b]Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Real Rock![/b] Hard rock, heavy metal, Nu metal, among others. A wide variety of rock, with original music or hit groups!
[*] Stylish and crazy graphics, with a [b]brutal [/b]finishing level
[*] TRUE Drums Set! A drums set that you will have to play and you can customize!
[*] More than 5h of only [b]CAMPAIGN![/b] Plus all the extras!
[*] Dozens of unlockables! Drumsticks, drums, songs...
[*] Intuitive gameplay for everyone. No dizziness. Play in a chair.
[*] Feel the rock n roll with advanced levels, make flourishes with the sticks and master the drums.
[*] PHASE enemies and boss, special levels and different worlds to discover.
[*] Online Ranking! Compete against your friends and beat their scores.
[*] Musical versions of other videogames!! Watch out!
[*] 4 levels of difficulty! For all levels and with a fair progression!
[*] More than 19 songs and new songs are incoming!
[*] With classic songs like [b]"I Love Rock 'N Roll" [/b] and [b]"Drink"[/b] by ALESTORM and more!
[*] Spectacular boss battles!
[/list]

notes.title: WISHLIST GOALS REVEAL!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello future [b]Drummers[/b]! [/h3]

We are setting up the release of [b]Drums Rock[/b] in [b]Early Acces[/b] and we need some help from you to get a good reception on the Steam VR comunity. For that reason, we prepared some special rewards to motivate your collaboration.

Let's take a look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42008690/c0cd4c264542f944c235a3cdf3ac50cb61b6e8d3.jpg[/img]

A lot of rewards are coming up !

[h3]We need a little of help to reach this milestones.[/h3]

Maybe someone of you is thinking about our ROADMAP (you can check it on the main page of the Steam listing)

But this Wishlist goals doesn't replace the Roadmap, is just an extra gift to our most important value for the studio: [b]our players. 
[/b]
